entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something I bought. It's a VeloBand Pulse, and honestly, it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I'm happy to help with a return. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's under [customer email address]. And look, I don't have a ton of time for this, so let's make it quick.
Okay, I see your order here. The VeloBand Pulse. And what is the reason for the return?
Like I said, it's not working for me. The readings are inaccurate, and it's just a pain to use. I want my money back.
I apologize for the inconvenience you're experiencing with your VeloBand Pulse. No problem at all. According to our return policy, you have 90 days to return items for a full refund.
90 days? Really? I thought it was shorter than that. Okay, well that's good to know. I've only had it for, like, 15 days. So, what's the next step?

Since you're well within the 90 days, I can go ahead and process the return for you. I'll send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Alright, that sounds easy enough. Will I get the full amount back?

Yes, you will receive a full refund to your original method of payment once the VeloBand Pulse is received and processed at our returns center. That usually takes 7-10 business days. It’s part of the standard return policy.
Okay, great. And just to be clear, this shipping label… it's free, right?
Yes, the shipping label is completely free. It will be in your inbox within the next few minutes. Just to confirm, your email address is [customer email address]?
Perfect. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks for making it so easy. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to contact us again. Have a great day!
